definitionZh: @position-try CSS at-rule 用于定义自定义位置尝试倒置选项,用于定义锁定位置元素的定位和对齐. 一组或多组位置尝试倒置选项,可以通过位置-Try倒置属性或位置-Try短手应用到锚定元素上. 当定位元素被移动到它开始溢出其包含的块或视图端口的位置时,浏览器会选择第一个位置尝试倒置选项,它发现将定位元素完全放回屏幕上.
sourceDefinition: The @position-try CSS at-rule is used to define a custom position try fallback option, which can be used to define positioning and alignment for anchor-positioned elements. One or more sets of position try fallback options can be applied to the anchored element via the position-try-fallbacks property or position-try shorthand. When the positioned element is moved to a position where it starts to overflow its containing block or the viewport, the browser will select the first position try fallback option it finds that places the positioned element fully back on-screen.
